checks.finding: No road right-of-way touches this parcel in Franklin County's right-of-way layer. The nearest mapped road, Seaman Rd, is about 107 m away in the county engineer's road layer. The Franklin County Auditor lists the parcel as "SEAMAN RD REAR".
checks.limitation: These layers show mapped right-of-way and road centerlines. They do not show recorded easements, private lanes, or other legal access, so they cannot establish whether the parcel has access.

checks.nextAction: Legal access, for example through a recorded easement or a private lane under §302.0391, needs title review and Franklin County zoning review.

checks.finding: Franklin County's zoning map places the whole parcel in the Rural (R) district. The parcel is in unincorporated Pleasant Township, where the county administers zoning. The Rural District permits one-family dwellings (§302.021) with at least 2.5 acres per dwelling (§302.041); the Franklin County Auditor lists 3.015 legal acres. About 5% of the parcel lies inside the Big Darby Creek Watershed riparian setback in the county's stream-buffer layer.
checks.limitation: A zoning map and a lot size are not a zoning certificate or a building permit. Road frontage (see access), setbacks, and the Big Darby riparian setback still have to be reviewed for any building plan.
